content: Patients returning for a follow-up consultation with the same doctor within 14 days of their previous visit are eligible for a 20% discount on the consultation fee for that single follow-up appointment. The discount applies only to the consultation fee and not to diagnostic tests, procedures, or prescribed medications. To claim the discount, patients must mention the follow-up visit at the time of check-in at the front desk and present their previous appointment receipt or show the appointment record in the clinic portal. The follow-up discount is not applicable in conjunction with other promotional offers or insurance-negotiated fee rates. Extended follow-up requirements (such as chronic disease management visits) are assessed individually by the treating doctor, who may recommend a personalised care plan with separate fee arrangements.
